svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Agentic Evaluation & Report Generation — Architecture Diagram
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Presentation Coaching Platform
Standard Interface: input(vector_store_location, metadata) → output(dimension, findings, scores, feedback)
Each agent retrieves embeddings from Vector Store → Bedrock reasoning → structured evaluation result
Bedrock AgentCore tools + prompts per dimension
1. SQS FIFO handoff message → Session Supervisor consumes → DDB status: Evaluating
2. Coaching Supervisor analyzes context → selects appropriate Evaluation Agents → invokes them (parallel/iterative)
3. Each Evaluation Agent retrieves embeddings from Vector Store → Bedrock reasoning → structured findings
4. Results stored in S3 → Report Generator aggregates → PDF coaching report → DDB status: Completed
Failures: DDB status: Failed + SNS notification + DLQ routing
